meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: Claude 会读取仓库所有未关闭的 issue 和 PR,每项在后台分析后,写出带 permalink 证据的报告到 /tmp 日期文件夹。它只读不改:不评论、不关闭、不合并、不改标签。
howto.when: 当你说出 "triage"、"triage issues"、"triage PRs" 等关键词(如 "github triage")时触发,它会对当前仓库做只读的 issue/PR 分析。

say.text: 对当前仓库的 open issues 做 triage
say.note: Claude 会逐项分析并生成报告

say.text: triage 一下 PR,把证据链接放进报告
say.note: 每项 PR 会生成一份带 permalink 的报告

say.text: github triage,只要报告不要动任何东西
say.note: 它是只读的,不会评论或合并

howto.what_en: Claude reads all open issues/PRs, analyzes each in a background subtask, writes permalink-backed reports to a /tmp dated folder. Read-only: no comments, closes, merges, or labels.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', or 'github triage'.

say_en.text: Run triage on open issues in this repo.
say_en.note: It analyzes each issue and writes reports.

say_en.text: Triage the PRs and include permalinks.
say_en.note: Each PR gets a report with evidence links.

say_en.text: Do a github triage, reports only.
say_en.note: Claude won't comment, close, or merge.
